title_zh: 城市智能体公共运行协议
title_en: Common Public Operating Protocol for Urban Agents

lifecycle.continue_when: source, users and civic necessity are explainable
lifecycle.stop_or_fallback: reject unclear or unnecessary uses and record the reason

lifecycle.continue_when: purpose, retention, prohibited uses, risk and accountable role are confirmed
lifecycle.stop_or_fallback: route unclear authority or purpose to existing human service

lifecycle.continue_when: isolation, evaluation, failure injection and exit resources are ready
lifecycle.stop_or_fallback: stop on unauthorised access, material bias or unexplainable output and revoke access

lifecycle.continue_when: an authorised person independently examines the evidence version
lifecycle.stop_or_fallback: return to the existing workflow and record override reasons

lifecycle.continue_when: scope, AI involvement, owner and appeal route are accessible
lifecycle.stop_or_fallback: do not scale when explanation or remedy is inaccessible

lifecycle.continue_when: remediation, deletion, revocation and recovery are verified
lifecycle.stop_or_fallback: provide progress and a checkable receipt to affected users

lifecycle.continue_when: sources, editor, version, validity and review date are complete

boundary_note: This file defines a proposed verification contract. It does not report completed field tests, approved thresholds, appointed public bodies or deployed government systems.
